description: apps/web runtime grows from a landing page into a product-shaped route shell built on top of the proven Stage 01 foundation.
steps: Bootstrap the real runtime shell on top of Stage 01 shared primitives and widgets
Expose navigable runtime routes instead of a single informational landing page
Keep Storybook and runtime aligned on the same UI foundation

description: Stage 02 provides truthful route shells for login, registration, and company onboarding without pretending that Stage 03 auth and master data are already live.
steps: Implement login and registration runtime shells
Implement company onboarding/profile shell mapped to the canonical flow doc
Make mock, seed, or stub boundaries explicit where domain persistence is not live yet

description: Equipment and contracts contours exist as runtime shells, including truthful empty/gated states and contractor-invite scaffolding, while live CRUD remains Stage 03 work.
steps: Implement equipment empty/add/import shells and subdivision selection shell
Implement contracts create flow shell and contractor lookup/invite shell
Represent request contour as a truthful gated placeholder until Stage 04

description: The repository converges toward a reproducible runtime/dev baseline for backend, web, and field contours together with health, env, CI, and smoke expectations; slice-001 advances only the web bootstrap part and must not claim the rest prematurely.
steps: Stabilize env contract and startup scripts
Land the shared web API/bootstrap layer and keep backend bootstrap assumptions explicit
Add backend health hooks, root startup contract, and apps/field baseline in later Stage 02 slices
Keep CI capable of lint/test/build/smoke for the new runtime baseline without claiming it done before proof

description: The imported Draw.io flow, the roadmap, and Stage 02 artifacts stay synchronized so later agents know exactly what moved into Stage 02 and what remains later.
steps: Import the Draw.io file into docs and create a canonical interpretation doc
Sync roadmap and frontend architecture with the revised Stage 02 boundary
Track the current slice through progress, evidence, and verifier artifacts
